verdict.rationale: The EC&VC page offers free public resources: an online investor-readiness tool that produces a personalised report, plus free downloadable UK and DE cap table templates. These are startup tools usable without being a client, but none of the named document types are evidenced. Missing for 10: incorporation document templates or generators, SAFE/term sheet templates, NDA templates, a broader document-generator library, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the resources are freely accessible.
